### California Passes AB-1856 For Open-Source Relief Over Age Verification

As an update to the May story about California's age verification law may end up exempting most Linux distributions, that AB-1856 bill has finally passed!

继五月份关于加州年龄验证法案可能最终豁免大多数 Linux 发行版的报道之后，AB-1856 法案终于通过了！

几个月来，加州《数字年龄保障法案》及其对 Linux/开源社区的影响一直备受关注，如今 AB-1856 法案的通过无疑是个好消息。该法案修订了相关保护措施和豁免条款，旨在简化开源平台的合规流程。

Tom's Hardware – 29 Aug 26

### California lawmakers unanimously pass Linux exemption from age-verification...

AB 1856 excludes open-source operating systems from the upcoming Digital Age Assurance Act.

### California’s Age Verification Bill Passes with Linux Exemption Intact

California lawmakers have approved AB 1856, requiring age signals from covered operating systems while keeping its open-source carve-out intact.
